description: List Dynamics 365 Sales records of one entity — accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, quotes or salesorders — newest change first, with readable labels for status and lookups (e.g. statuscode_label, parentaccountid_name). Filters: search (contains on name/e-mail/number), account_id (contacts, leads, opportunities, quotes and orders of that account), open_only, modified_since, and an optional OData `filter` (e.g. "estimatedvalue gt 10000"). Read-only.

fields.description: logical names for $select; default a compact set per entity

filter.description: OData $filter on logical names; lookups as _parentaccountid_value eq <GUID>

name: list_dynamics_records
